title: checklist: eleven M1 items name scratch package ids that objectstack build refuses (underscore)
body:
domain:devx#2 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzjFj4aaaJk1VJLqRdC

## What is wrong

Eleven platform-checklist items written by M1 (#32035, epic #32022) spell their scratch package manifest ids with an underscore. `objectstack build` refuses each: "Invalid package id 'com.qa.addr_a' … underscores are not admitted. Did you mean 'com.qa.addr-a'?". A runner who follows the fixture literally cannot install the pair.

- `com.qa.addr_a` / `com.qa.addr_b`: `api-backend.meta-qualified-item-read`, `api-backend.actions-namespace-address`, `api-backend.automation-namespace-address` (`addr_b` only), `access-security.permission-set-package-resolution`, `access-security.sharing-queue-assignment-package-resolution`, `access-security.permission-set-address-in-execution-context`, `ai.mcp-namespace-faces`, `automation.flow-reference-package-resolution`, `integration-system.job-package-key`, `platform-core.bare-name-one-holder-refusal`.
- `com.qa.n_one` / `com.qa.n_two`: `platform-core.namespace-co-owner-name-refusal`.

`api-backend.meta-qualified-item-read` also quotes the ids in its steps and expected messages.

Found by the M4 verification run (#32270, PR #32316), recorded in `docs/qa/platform-checklist/FOLLOW-UPS.md` §19b. That run used `com.qa.addr-a` / `com.qa.addr-b` with the namespaces `qa_a` / `qa_b` unchanged, and passed.

## Acceptance

- Each listed item's fixture (and, where quoted, steps and expected text) spells the package id with a hyphen. The namespaces `qa_a`, `qa_b`, `n_one`, `n_two` stay as they are: a namespace admits an underscore.
- Each edited item bumps `revision` and appends a `history` row (a fixture-text correction, no clause change).
- `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs` exits 0.
- Only `docs/qa/platform-checklist/**`; `skip-changeset`.
